However, engagement later dropped off as user retention remained low and the initial viral momentum faded.

projects.name: NextFlow
projects.description: NextflowAI is a collaborative AI workflow studio for generative media - build, connect, and run modular nodes to generate images, videos, and text. It supports real-time collaboration, asset management, extensible triggers, and multimodal inputs (text, image, video) for hybrid AI-driven pipelines.
